channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Reel to double-job following Ardee appointment
item.description: Fergal Reel will combine the roles of Louth U20 and Ardee, St Mary's senior football managers in 2026.

item.title: Croker to host Leinster club finals double-header once again
item.description: Croke Park will once again host a double-header of Leinster club senior football and hurling finals next month.

item.title: GAA Pitches get a game-changing Boost with Ireland's New SPECTRO 442 Paint
item.description: KELLS-based coatings company, European Industrial Coatings, are delighted to announce the launch of SPECTRO 442, a new high performance, ready-to-use line marking paint engineered to provide unparalleled clarity and durability for all natural grass sports pitches across Ireland.

item.title: Civic reception planned for Declan Hannon
item.description: A civic reception is in the pipeline for recently-retired Limerick hurling star Declan Hannon.

item.title: Doran targets promotion
item.description: New Antrim football manager Mark Doran is setting his sights on promotion from Division 4 of the Allianz League.

item.title: Coffey and Dooley scoop Laois awards
item.description: Portarlington football captain Ronan Coffey and Rosenallis hurler David Dooley have been named as the respective Inter-County Players of the Year in the annual Laois GAA Awards.

item.title: Rainbow appointed Raheens manager
item.description: Anthony Rainbow has been named as the new Raheens senior football manager.

item.title: 'He deserves everything he gets'
item.description: Walter Walsh strongly supports the idea of GAA players cashing in on their profile.

item.title: Fitzgerald received death threats over Hegarty incident
item.description: Aaron Fitzgerald says he received death threats following an incident with Gearoid Hegarty in the 2022 Munster SHC which led to the Limerick forward being sent off.

item.title: Meyler hangs up his Tyrone boots
item.description: Tyrone All-Ireland SFC winner Conor Meyler has announced his inter-county retirement.
